name: robots/mobile-robots-group-uc3m__adamsim
title: ADAMSim ADAM mobile base
intro: ADAMSim ADAM mobile base, adapted from mobile-robots-group-uc3m/adamsim. It reads `camera_angle`, `left_arm_joint_positions` and `right_arm_joint_positions`; runs `drive` and `stop_motion`. `drive`: drive a mobile base with a commanded linear and angular velocity for a bounded duration, or to a target pose. Obstacle and zone limits are enforced by the binding safety envelope. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
